pwa.installPrompt: Install the app for quick access

1.title: Connect with your therapist
1.body: Find the clinic and send a request. After approval, you are linked.

2.title: Get today’s plan
2.body: The exercises your therapist prescribed appear on your phone, with counts and guidance.

3.title: Do them and report back
3.body: Finish the session and note how hard it felt. Your therapist sees what happened between visits.

features.title: What patients and therapists can do in Zivan
features.lead: Each role gets its own tools — the most useful ones first.
features.patientLead: See today’s plan, do the work, and keep your therapist in the loop.
features.doctorTitle: If you are a therapist or clinic
features.doctorLead: Prescribe programs, track adherence, and follow patients between visits.

1.title: Today’s exercises on your phone
1.body: A clear day list with counts and guidance. Open it, do it, done.

2.title: Exercise reminders
2.body: On busy days, a reminder helps the plan not get lost.

3.title: Effort and progress notes
3.body: Say if it felt hard or better — your therapist can adjust the next plan.

4.title: Link to your therapist
4.body: The program comes from your clinic so you stay on the same path.

5.title: Learning materials
5.body: Exercises and short articles when you want clearer guidance.

1.title: Prescribe exercise programs
1.body: Build a plan for each patient and set dosage for every move.

2.title: Track home adherence
2.body: See what got done between visits — and where patients stalled.

3.title: Manage patients
3.body: Patient list, link status, and quick access to exercise history.

4.title: History and feedback
4.body: Session effort notes and progress trends for clearer clinical decisions.

5.title: AI assist (coming soon)
5.body: Draft programs and weekly summaries — final control stays with you.

trust.title: Why you can trust Zivan
trust.lead: We are early. So we stay clear, reachable, and careful with your information.

1.title: Real support
1.body: We offer 24/7 support. If something gets stuck, call us or use the smart chatbot.

2.title: Data confidentiality
2.body: Your account and care-related information stay confidential and are not shared for unrelated use.

3.title: The therapist decides
3.body: Treatment plans are set and approved by the therapist. Our tools assist; they do not replace clinical judgment.

trust.founderNote: We built Zivan to shorten the gap between the clinic visit and home practice. If you have a question or concern, tell us directly.

ai.title: AI is on the way
ai.lead: This part is not finished yet. The aim is to help therapists and patients, with final control always staying with the therapist.

1.title: Exercise ideas by body area
1.body: Based on the selected area, a few exercise ideas are prepared for the therapist to review.

2.title: Draft program
2.body: Builds a draft from patient information. The therapist edits and finalizes it.

3.title: Weekly summary for therapists
3.body: A short weekly overview of completed exercises for easier follow-up.

4.title: Better reminder timing
4.body: Reminders move closer to the hours when exercises are more likely to get done.

5.title: Movement guidance
5.body: Patients can ask how to do a move correctly and get plain guidance.

about.title: About Zivan
about.story: We saw strong plans stall after people left the clinic. Zivan exists so patients know what to do each day, and therapists can see how home practice is going.
about.team: Zivan’s co-founders started the product path, and today they work alongside colleagues in development, support, and improving the user experience. If you have a question, contact us directly.

legal.privacyLead: This policy explains what data Zivan collects, why we collect it, how we keep it, and what rights you have.
legal.privacyControllerBody: Zivan is provided by the Zivan team. For privacy questions, contact phone support.
legal.privacyWhatBody: Depending on your role (patient, therapist, or clinic manager), we may process:
privacyWhatItems: Account details: name, phone number, role, and hashed password
Care relationships: patient–therapist/clinic links and request status
Exercise data: prescribed programs, completions, effort notes, and progress
Technical data needed for security and reliability: session identifiers, device/browser type, and error logs
legal.privacyUseBody: We use data only to provide and improve the service:
privacyUseItems: Show exercise plans and send reminders
Let therapists follow adherence between visits
Protect accounts, prevent abuse, and provide support
Improve product quality in aggregate form where possible
legal.privacyShareBody: Care-related information stays within the patient–therapist/clinic relationship. We do not sell data for third-party ads. We may process data with trusted infrastructure providers under confidentiality, or when required by law, only as needed.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: We keep data while your account is active and needed for the service. After account deletion or a valid request, we delete or anonymize identifiable data within a reasonable period, unless short-term retention is required for legal or security reasons.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You may request access, correction, account deletion, or restriction of processing. Contact phone support and we will review your request.
legal.privacySecurityBody: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures (including secure transport and role-based access). No system is risk-free; if a significant incident occurs, we will notify as required.
legal.privacyChildrenBody: If a user is under the legal age of consent, registration and use should happen with guardian supervision and consent.
legal.privacyChangesBody: We may update this policy. The latest version will be published on this page with an updated date.
legal.privacyContactBody: Call phone support with questions or requests:
legal.termsLead: By creating an account or using Zivan, you agree to these terms. Please read them before continuing.
legal.termsServiceBody: Zivan is a digital tool for prescribing, viewing, and completing physiotherapy exercises at home. Product features may change, expand, or be limited over time.
legal.termsMedicalBody: Zivan does not replace in-person clinical diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a therapist. Clinical decisions, prescriptions, and program approval belong to the treating therapist or clinic. If you have severe pain, worrying symptoms, or a medical emergency, seek care immediately.
legal.termsAccountsBody: You are responsible for accurate registration details and for keeping your account secure. Sharing passwords, providing false information, or unauthorized use of another account is not allowed. If you suspect unauthorized access, contact support right away.
legal.termsAcceptBody: When using Zivan, you agree to:
termsAcceptItems: Use the service only for lawful purposes related to care and prescribed exercise
Keep login credentials confidential and not share them
As a patient, follow the prescribed plan per therapist guidance and log honest feedback
As a therapist/clinic, prescribe only for linked patients under your professional responsibility
legal.termsRolesBody: Patient, therapist, and clinic manager have separate roles with role-based access. Patient–therapist/clinic links are established after the other party approves.
termsProhibitedItems: Abuse, hacking, disrupting the service, or attempting unauthorized access
Uploading or distributing illegal, misleading, or rights-infringing content
Unauthorized commercial use of Zivan content, brand, or data
legal.termsIpBody: The Zivan name, logo, interface, educational content, and software belong to Zivan unless stated otherwise. Personal use within the service is allowed; copying or redistribution without written permission is not.
legal.termsLiabilityBody: We aim for a stable and accurate service, but technical interruptions, user error, or infrastructure issues may occur. Zivan is not responsible for clinical decisions, treatment outcomes, or indirect damages arising from use or inability to use the service, except where law requires otherwise.
legal.termsChangesBody: We may update these terms. The latest version will be published on this page. Continued use after publication means you accept the updated terms.
legal.termsContactBody: For questions about these terms, call phone support:
